conversion_rate.label: Conversion rate
conversion_rate.definition: Sessions that reached purchase, divided by all sessions.
conversion_rate.reason: This source records completed orders only, so every session in it converted by construction. A session-denominated rate computed here would be 100% or undefined, not a finding.

aov.label: Average order value
aov.definition: Total revenue divided by the number of orders.

revenue_per_visitor.label: Revenue per visitor
revenue_per_visitor.definition: Total revenue divided by all sessions, converting or not.
revenue_per_visitor.reason: This source records completed orders only, so every session in it converted by construction. A session-denominated rate computed here would be 100% or undefined, not a finding.

cart_abandonment_rate.label: Cart abandonment rate
cart_abandonment_rate.definition: Sessions that added to cart but never purchased, divided by sessions that added to cart.
cart_abandonment_rate.reason: This source records completed orders only, so every session in it converted by construction. A session-denominated rate computed here would be 100% or undefined, not a finding.

search_to_purchase_rate.label: Search-to-purchase rate
search_to_purchase_rate.definition: Sessions that used search AND purchased, divided by sessions that used search.
search_to_purchase_rate.reason: This source records completed orders only, so every session in it converted by construction. A session-denominated rate computed here would be 100% or undefined, not a finding.

items_per_order.label: Items per order
items_per_order.definition: Total items divided by the number of orders.

clv_historical.label: Customer lifetime value
clv_historical.definition: Mean observed revenue per attributed customer to date. Historical, not projected.
